rules.title: Homebrew downloads
rules.reason: Downloaded bottles and source archives. Homebrew fetches them again when needed (same as `brew cleanup -s`).

rules.title: npm cache
rules.reason: Content-addressed package cache. npm re-downloads packages on the next install.

rules.title: Yarn cache
rules.reason: Global package cache. Yarn re-downloads packages on the next install.

rules.title: pnpm metadata cache
rules.reason: Registry metadata and dlx caches. Rebuilt automatically.

rules.title: pnpm content store
rules.reason: Projects hard-link packages from this store, so removing it frees less than its size until those node_modules folders are removed too. Prefer `pnpm store prune`.

rules.title: Bun install cache
rules.reason: Global package cache. Bun re-downloads packages on the next install.

rules.title: node-gyp headers
rules.reason: Node.js headers used to compile native modules. Downloaded again when a native module is built.

rules.title: pip cache
rules.reason: Downloaded wheels and HTTP cache. pip re-downloads as needed (same as `pip cache purge`).

rules.title: pip-audit cache
rules.reason: Vulnerability-database cache. Rebuilt on the next audit.

rules.title: uv cache
rules.reason: Package and build cache. uv re-downloads as needed (same as `uv cache clean`).

rules.title: Poetry cache
rules.reason: Package cache and virtualenv store for Poetry. Packages are re-downloaded on demand.

rules.title: Puppeteer browsers
rules.reason: Headless browser builds. Downloaded again by `npm install` in projects that use Puppeteer.

rules.title: Playwright browsers
rules.reason: Browser builds for testing. Restore with `npx playwright install`.

rules.title: Chrome for Testing downloads
rules.reason: Browser builds downloaded by test tooling. Fetched again when tests run.

rules.title: Prisma engines
rules.reason: Query-engine binaries. Prisma downloads them again on generate.

rules.title: ccache
rules.reason: C/C++ compiler output cache. Only makes the next build slower.

rules.title: CocoaPods cache
rules.reason: Downloaded pod sources. Fetched again on `pod install`.

rules.title: Gradle caches
rules.reason: Dependency and wrapper caches. Gradle re-downloads on the next build.

rules.title: Maven local repository
rules.reason: Usually re-downloadable, but may hold locally installed artifacts that exist nowhere else.

rules.title: Cargo registry cache
rules.reason: Downloaded crate sources. Cargo fetches them again on the next build.

rules.title: Go build cache
rules.reason: Compiler output cache (same as `go clean -cache`).

rules.title: Xcode DerivedData
rules.reason: Build products and indexes. Xcode rebuilds them; the next build is slower.

rules.title: Xcode device support files
rules.reason: Debug symbols copied from connected devices. Copied again when a device connects.

rules.title: Xcode archives
rules.reason: Archived app builds and their debug symbols. Needed to symbolicate crash reports for shipped versions.

rules.title: Simulator caches
rules.reason: Simulator runtime caches. Rebuilt when a simulator boots.

rules.title: Hugging Face models
rules.reason: Downloaded model weights. They can be downloaded again, but that may be many gigabytes, and gated models need a login.

rules.title: Hugging Face datasets
rules.reason: Downloaded and preprocessed datasets. They can be fetched again, but large or gated datasets take time and may need a login.

rules.title: Hugging Face transfer cache
rules.reason: Chunk cache used while downloading. Models in the hub folder do not depend on it.

rules.title: Ollama models
rules.reason: Local LLM weights. Restore with `ollama pull`. Custom models built from a Modelfile need rebuilding.

rules.title: LM Studio models
rules.reason: Local LLM weights downloaded through LM Studio. Can be downloaded again.

rules.title: PyTorch hub cache
rules.reason: Pretrained weights downloaded by torch.hub and torchvision. Fetched again on first use.

rules.title: Docker Desktop disk
rules.reason: Holds all images, containers and volumes, including databases. Use `docker system prune` instead of deleting this.

rules.title: User logs
rules.reason: Diagnostic logs written by apps. Not needed unless you are debugging a problem.

rules.title: Trash
rules.reason: Items you already deleted. Emptying the Trash is permanent, so KachraClean only reports it.
